cutoff.meaning: The strike deadline set by the union.

negative_condition: No agreement is recorded as accepted by both sides before the deadline.
positive_condition: An agreement is recorded as accepted by both sides before the deadline.

proof.meaning: A record that a negotiator accepted the other side's tabled offer at the table, as per mediation protocol.
proof.name: agreement_record
proof.subject: both sides

terminal_meaning: Whether a signed wage agreement has been recorded as accepted by both sides before the strike deadline of 2026-10-31T23:59:00-05:00.
